answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Telescope maker astrolabe plate assay attested by the almanac hall flips the bet — each astrolabe plate is an eclipse record countersigned by the warden, so a farm must grind a hundred real lenses by hand — and the relic lands on the attacker instead.
